FIXED Aug 25: api/comps.js accepts ?customid=, sanitizes it to [a-z0-9._-] max 64 (which also strips ',' and CRLF, making it safe to interpolate into X-EBAY-C-ENDUSERCTX), and appends affiliateReferenceId=<id> to the affiliate header. Deliberately a QUERY PARAM not a Referer sniff: the response is CDN-cached (s-maxage=900) and a header-derived value would not vary the cache key, so one page's cached response could hand its custom ID to another page's visitors. All 9 callers tagged: 7 guide pages by slug, watchlist -> 'vault', price-engine snapshot -> 'price-engine'. Response now echoes customId + affiliateTagged for auditing.
